title: Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Cancellation Refund: License Refund and Its Ceiling
content:
## Refund clause

This clause sets the refund on the whole-subscription cancellation of a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription whose billing cycle runs its whole term.

**(1) Cycle, cycle amount and licenses refunded.**

- For the cancellation refund, the cycle is the current term, from the term start date through the term end date. Its days are counted from the first day through the last day inclusive.
- The refund's cycle amount per license is the unit price for a P1M term, and twelve times the unit price for a P1Y term billed annually.
- The licenses refunded are the licenses the subscription holds when it is cancelled.

**(2) Charges billed for the cycle.** These are the cycle charge, plus the partial-cycle charges whose cycle starts on the term start date.

**(3) License refund.** The license refund is the refund's cycle amount per license, times the licenses refunded, times the calendar days from the cancellation date through the last day of the cycle inclusive, divided by the days in the cycle. It is never more than the charges billed for the cycle.

**(4) Cancellation refund.** The cancellation refund is the license refund. Stratton Bay's administration fee is left as billed.

**(4a) Ceiling on charges deducted.** Charges deducted from a cancellation refund never take, together, more than half (50 percent) of the refund they are deducted from, that is the license refund with any amounts returned. A cancellation therefore always carries a refund above 0.00. For example, on a hypothetical license refund with amounts returned of 200.00 USD, the charges deducted together take no more than 100.00.

**(5) Covered work.** Stratton Bay makes no license-work charge against the cancellation refund of a client holding a ClearPath agreement whose status is active or notice given and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 administration, because that work is covered.

**(6) Rounding.** The refund is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

The subscription is on a P1Y term billed annually, with a unit price of 10.00 USD, so the cycle amount per license is 120.00. The term runs from 1 March to 28 February, which is 365 days. 20 licenses are held, and the cancellation is on 5 March, leaving 361 days.

| Case | Charges billed for the cycle | License refund before the ceiling | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cycle charge of 2400.00 | 2400.00 | 120.00 times 20 times 361, divided by 365, which is 2373.69863 | 2373.70 USD |
| Cycle charge of 1920.00, with no partial-cycle charge for 4 added licenses | 1920.00 | 2373.69863 | 1920.00 USD (held at the charges billed) |
| Cycle charge of 1920.00, plus a partial-cycle charge of 470.00 starting on the term start date | 2390.00 | 2373.69863 | 2373.70 USD |
